attributes.name: Curse of the Sphinx
attributes.powers:
While displayed, before you explore, examine the top card of your location deck; if it is a boon, recharge your hand, then reset your hand, then discard a card.

If you already have the Curse of the Sphinx displayed, banish this card.

"I watch over all! There is no escaping my gaze!"
